title: Upgrade the vendored money library for its fromDecimal fix without changing VAT, discounts or the support form
measures: Upgrades centwise 2.4 to 3.0 and, beyond the breaks the visible tests show (percentOf renamed percent, format needing a currency), handles the two silent breaking changes in the changelog at every call site: the default rounding of percent/multiply flipped from half-up to half-even (VAT in billing and discount codes in promotions change on half-cent results, while loyalty already passes rounding 'down'), and parse now throws instead of returning null (the support tool's goodwill credit form, not named in the prompt, turns a typo into an exception instead of a form error; tryParse keeps the old contract).
prompt: Supplier price imports lose a cent on some prices (a 19.99 price comes in as 1998 cents). centwise 3.0 fixes fromDecimal, so please upgrade us from 2.4.1 to 3.0; the release is already unpacked in vendor-next/centwise/.

commits.message: feat: billing, promotions, support credits and supplier prices on vendored centwise 2.4.1, centwise 3.0 unpacked for the upgrade
